meta.title: Harrow & Vale | Employment law for employees

seo.description: Harrow & Vale: employment law for employees. Unfair dismissal, discrimination, settlement agreements. First consultation free, 30 minutes.

props.content: We act for employees, not employers.
Harrow & Vale is a four-lawyer firm handling unfair dismissal, discrimination and settlement agreements. Your first consultation is 30 minutes, free, by phone or video.

props.alt: A plain folder, blank papers and a pen on a quiet table.

props.content: Three areas of employment law, always on the employee's side.
If you have been dismissed and believe it was unfair, talk it through with us.
If you have been treated unfairly at work because of who you are, we can help you understand where you stand.
If your employer has offered a settlement agreement, we go through it with you before you sign.

props.alt: A phone and a closed notebook on a simple table.

props.content: A first conversation costs you nothing. Tell us what happened, and we will talk it through with you plainly.
Harrow & Vale is a small firm by design: four lawyers, working only for employees.

props.alt: A sealed envelope resting on a document folder.

props.content: Talk to us before you decide anything
First consultation: 30 minutes, free, by phone or video.
